sources.officialityEvidence: The live 2026 DRC Foreign Ministry service page identifies the competent embassy or consulate for a visa filing, but gives no nationality eligibility or exemption schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Vous devez vous présenter personnellement auprès de l’ambassade ou du consulat ... compétent(e).

sources.title: EVISA DGM
sources.officialityEvidence: The live DGM-linked portal exposes public country and visa API route names, but normal GET requests to /api/countries and /api/visa-types return its application shell rather than a nationality outcome.
sources.supportingExcerpt: l'application EVISA DGM ne fonctionne pas correctement si JavaScript est activé.

unresolved.reason: No current DRC or Zimbabwean primary source directly maps an ordinary Zimbabwean passport to visa-free entry or identifies an issuance route. The DRC portal has no reproducible nationality result and generic consular filing is not a nationality complement. SADC membership is not used as evidence of a waiver.

No current DRC or Republic-of-the-Congo primary source directly maps an ordinary Republic-of-the-Congo passport to visa-free entry or identifies an issuance route. The DRC portal has no reproducible nationality result and generic consular filing is not a nationality complement. CEMAC does not establish this DRC destination rule, and similarly named Congo sources are not transferred.
